# Stockroom Basics

## What you build

A small stockroom sheet, `stockroom.csv`, with a count for every shelf and a
reorder point for every item. It is a spreadsheet, not a system, on purpose: the
point is the habit of counting the same way twice.

## Topics this course must cover

- stock counting
- shelf labelling
- reorder points

## Who this is for

Someone who has never kept an inventory. You need a text editor and a terminal.

## How this course teaches

- **You do the counting.** The tutor sets one task at a time and reads your sheet.
- **Placement first.** A short placement check decides which level each objective
  starts at, so you are not made to repeat what you already do.
- **Evidence, not assertion.** A lesson finishes when the sheet exists and you can
  explain how the count was taken.

## The lessons

**00 - Setup.** Create the sheet and the notes folder.

**01 - Placement.** A short check of the three objectives, which sets the level
each one starts at.

**02 - Counting a shelf.** Take a repeatable count and label the shelf.

## Where to go after this

The next module in the programme, Stockroom Forecasting, starts from the sheet you
finish with here.
